Looks like something is wrong on the ggplot2 side with the most recent
update of ggplot2. See this thread:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/82a6b83c101ec188

Try reinstalling ggplot2, though it may take a couple days for the
fixed version to reach your download mirror.
